attempts.text:
**The anchor is `narK` alone.** Column 0 is the one spine of the window: `narK`, carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls with 0.15 bits.

**Then the graph opens wide.** Columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 82% of calls, named in 78 to 100% (mean 92%). A second branch of 8 families runs through columns 1 to 8, carried by 11% of chromosomes, persistent: `narG` to `rssB`, [[nitrate reduction]]. Another branch of 15 families, `oppA` to `ompW`, [[oligopeptide transport]], runs through columns 16 to 30, also 11%.

**The middle is a run of forks.** `hemA` to `emtA` through the `dha` and `tre` genes, most carried in 87 to 89% of chromosomes, and a branch of 3 families at columns 31 to 33, shell, carried by 29 to 30%. Then columns 34 to 40 are variable, 72 to 89%, and columns 42 to 56 variable, 51 to 88%, `umuC` to `ymgG`, [[DNA repair and cell division]].

**Hesitation peaks late.** Column 59, `ymgC`, is the most hesitant at 1.09 bits, in a region of plasticity in 70% of calls; columns 58 and 60 follow at 1.05 and 1.08 bits. The 14 columns mostly inside a region of plasticity are named in 86% of calls at 0.82 bits, the other 66 in 94% at 0.37 bits.

**The window ends at `pepT`.** Columns 68 to 78 are variable, 7 to 69%, `fabI` to `roxA`, and column 79 is a fork, `pepT`, carried by 40% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.19 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 96%.

label: narK
facts:
WINDOW: the narK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor narK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,470 to 2,549 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying narK once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.45 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,064 calls, named 98%, 0.18 bits; shell 11,353 calls, named 80%, 0.99 bits; cloud 623 calls, named 29%, 3.78 bits. Outside an RGP 33,636 calls, named 96%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 9,404 calls, named 78%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 36 fork, 43 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 96%); 9,404 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 59 (ymgC) 1.09 bits, RGP 70%; column 60 (ariR) 1.08 bits, RGP 70%; column 58 (pdeG) 1.05 bits, RGP 65%. The 14 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.82 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 94%, 0.37 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-82%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: narK. named 99%; 0.15 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-82%. named 78-100% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 59, named 78%, 1.09 bits.
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 1-8, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all P; the branch's families: narG, narH, narJ, narI, purU, ychJ, rssA, rssB
